Coal.note: Normalizing global thermal inventories and subdued seaborne demand limit upside.

Manganese.note: South African logistical bottlenecks tighten supply despite steady steel demand.

PGM.note: Ample above-ground stocks and sluggish global auto production constrain pricing.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production caps and robust solar demand tighten the global balance.
